scope: Native XP 3DMark05 disk-path fixture setup; no benchmark completion claim.
problem: Original Boost filesystem code rejects the EXE at E drive root with invalid name /3DMark05.exe in E://3DMark05.exe. E:/./ normalizes to the same path. The C NTFS volume has only 290492416 bytes free, insufficient for the original DAT.
change: NV_BENCH_LAUNCH includes a separate NVJUNC.EXE. Invoked explicitly, it creates a new C:/NV05RUN directory junction to E:/ through the original XP FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT API. It refuses any existing directory and never overwrites or deletes guest files. Original game images remain read-only with all changes in sector overlays.

nativeProof.junction: Observed SET_REPARSE=00000001 and EXE_ATTRIBUTES=00000020. The shared NVUI.TXT was subsequently overwritten by UI inspection; the observation is recorded here and the successfully launched native UI below remains independently inspectable.
nativeProof.launch: C:/NV05RUN/3DMark05.exe entered the original Business Edition main window with defaults: three game tests, two CPU tests, 1024x768, no AA, Optimal filtering, VS/PS 3_0 and fixed frame rate Off.
nativeProof.modal: Process-scoped NVUI enumerated 3DMark05.exe PID 0x62c, its Tip Of The Day window and standard Button controls. Native checkbox and OK handlers dismissed it.
nativeProof.run: Original GUI closed with EXIT_CODE=0. CLI default five then entered GT1 and real rendering. That run later trapped at Curie 0x17D0, followed by object errors and incorrect blue lighting; it is not accepted as a graphics or completion pass.

validation: Native XP junction creation, original Business Edition UI and normal process exit
limits: Junction setup is explicit and XP NTFS specific; it is not automatically applied to existing guest images.
Original benchmark, renderer, driver and graphics API code are unchanged by this filesystem helper.
Default five, feature five, batch six and image quality remain open.
